Grabowiec Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Grabowiec-Góra, Poland

Demolished. Grabowiec's Jewish community, granted no special privileges but treated favorably by local officials, bought properties near the market square in the first half of the 18th century to build a synagogue complex; the population reached 1,721 (63 percent of the town) by 1921. In 1942, Grabowiec Ghetto Jews were deported to the Sobibór death camp. This, the older of Grabowiec's two Jewish cemeteries, was established in 1720 and used until 1900; it was wrecked by the Germans during WWII, its matzevot used for construction. Of 29 tombstones later recovered from the area, three originate from this cemetery, the oldest dated 1812.
